changes.note: ZSG low-water timetable (zsg.ch/en/traffic-conditions/, PDF Niedrigwasser-Fahrplan_V7, valid from 19.10.26, no end date; read 2026-10-18). The Large Lake Cruise is a round trip from Bürkliplatz: 11:20 via Horgen, 13:20 via Meilen. Only the outward legs are in the public timetable; their returns (arriving Bürkliplatz 13:05 and 15:05) are not, so they can't be shown.

ZSG low-water timetable (as above): the Small lake cruise runs only Bürkliplatz - Kilchberg, daily 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:30, 15:30, 16:30. The public timetable has 13:30 (Kurs 35) instead of 14:30 (Kurs 41), so 13:30 is withdrawn and 14:30 can't be shown.

ZSG low-water timetable (as above): Küsnacht and Erlenbach are not served; the Thalwil boat calls at Küsnacht Goldbach instead, which is not a pier in our data. The whole line is withdrawn until Goldbach is added or the notice ends.
